edge_cases.outcome: The outstanding accounts of its method lines must carry that same currency, and the account rules refuse a mismatch with the message that the foreign currency set on the journal and on the account must be the same.

worked_examples.description: A bank journal with one money-in method and one money-out method
worked_examples.narrative: Each set holds the outstanding account of the method lines of its direction.

records.name: The end-to-end ledger walkthrough
records.purpose: Composes the calculations of the domain over one accounting year of one company, so that a rebuild can check that the opening entry, the numbering, the reversal, the foreign-currency matching, the exchange difference, the locking and the hashing all agree with one another.

operands.name: the company currency and its rounding step
operands.unit_or_currency: euro, with a rounding step of 0.01
operands.source: the company
operands.constraints: fixed for the whole walkthrough

operands.name: the fiscal year end
operands.source: the company
operands.constraints: the thirty-first of December, so the fiscal year is the calendar year

operands.name: the current date
operands.source: the clock
operands.constraints: the tenth of March two thousand and twenty-six

operands.name: the accounts and journals of the chart
operands.source: the generic chart loaded into the company
operands.constraints: the codes and journal codes are reproduced exactly

preconditions.condition: A chart of accounts has been loaded and the journals exist.
preconditions.otherwise: The opening entry cannot be created and the operation fails with the message asking for a chart of accounts or a miscellaneous journal.

preconditions.condition: The company has an exchange journal, a loss account and a gain account.
preconditions.otherwise: The exchange difference of the seventh step cannot be produced.

procedure: Load the chart: among the accounts created are 400000 Suppliers of the Payable type and reconcilable, 411000 Customers of the Receivable type and reconcilable, 550000 Bank of the Bank and Cash type, 600000 Purchases of the Expenses type, 700000 Sales of the Income type, 999999 Profit or Loss Appropriation of the Current Year Earnings type, 550001 Bank Suspense Account of the Current Assets type, 550002 Outstanding Receipts of the Current Assets type and reconcilable, 550003 Outstanding Payments of the Current Assets type and reconcilable, 999997 Cash Discount Gain, 999998 Cash Discount Loss, 999001 Cash Difference Gain, 999002 Cash Difference Loss and 580000 Liquidity Transfer; the journals created are INV Sales, BILL Purchases, MISC Miscellaneous Operations, EXCH Exchange Difference, CABA Cash Basis Taxes and BNK1 Bank.

Record the opening entry dated the thirty-first of December two thousand and twenty-five in the journal MISC, with Bank 12 000.00 debit, Customers 5 000.00 debit and Suppliers 3 000.00 credit, balanced by a credit of 14 000.00 on the Profit or Loss Appropriation account, and post it so that it takes the number MISC/2025/12/0001.

Book a miscellaneous accrual on the fifth of March two thousand and twenty-six of 1 200.00, debit Purchases and credit Suppliers, posted as MISC/2026/03/0001 because the March chain is new and December two thousand and twenty-five is a different period; the entry balances, no lock date is violated and no hash is taken because MISC does not secure.
Post a second entry of 800.00 on the seventh of March, which takes MISC/2026/03/0002.

Reverse the accrual on the thirty-first of March with the reference "Reversal of: MISC/2026/03/0001", crediting Purchases by 1 200.00 and debiting Suppliers by 1 200.00; the reversal takes MISC/2026/03/0003, is posted immediately because the original is a plain entry and the reversal date is not in the future, and the two items on 400000 are reconciled into a Full Reconciliation whose identifier becomes their matching number.

Post a customer invoice on the first of April in the journal INV for 1 000.00 foreign units at 1.05 foreign units per euro: Customers 952.38 debit with a foreign amount of 1 000.00 and Sales 952.38 credit with a foreign amount of minus 1 000.00, numbered INV/2026/00001 because a sale journal numbers yearly; the total in the document currency is 1 000.00 and the signed company total is 952.38.

Record the payment on the twentieth of May at a rate of 1.10 in the journal BNK1: Bank 909.09 debit with a foreign amount of 1 000.00 and Customers 909.09 credit with a foreign amount of minus 1 000.00; match the two receivable items in the foreign currency for 1 000.00 units, which converts back to 952.38 and 909.09 euros, outside each other's tolerance ranges, so the matched amount in euros is 909.09; the invoice item keeps 43.29 euros with nothing open in foreign units, so an exchange difference of plus 43.29 is produced in the journal EXCH dated the twentieth of May, crediting Customers by 43.29 and debiting the exchange loss account by 43.29, and the first of the two is matched with the invoice item so that a Full Reconciliation covers the three receivable items.

Close the quarter on the fifth of July by setting the Global Lock Date to the thirtieth of June two thousand and twenty-six, the validation checking that no unreconciled bank transaction exists on or before that date; afterwards a new entry dated the fifteenth of June has its accounting date moved out of the locked period, modifying MISC/2026/03/0001 is refused with "You cannot add/modify entries prior to and inclusive of: Global Lock Date (06/30/2026).", and a lock exception granted to one accountant until the tenth of July, relaxing the Global Lock Date to the thirty-first of May two thousand and twenty-six, lets that accountant modify a June entry while nobody else can.

Secure the half-year on the fifteenth of July by switching the hash on for the journal MISC and running the secure-entries operation up to the thirtieth of June two thousand and twenty-six: the chain with the prefix MISC/2025/12/ holds MISC/2025/12/0001 and the chain with the prefix MISC/2026/03/ holds MISC/2026/03/0001, 0002 and 0003, both are contiguous, neither holds an unreconciled bank transaction, so four entries are hashed in ascending counter order per chain and each receives "This journal entry has been secured."; from then on none of them can be reset to draft, renumbered, edited in a hashed field, or have an item deleted.

Close the year on the thirty-first of December two thousand and twenty-six by posting the profit-or-loss appropriation entry by hand, moving the balance of the income and expense accounts to the retained-earnings account, then setting the Global Lock Date to the thirty-first of December two thousand and twenty-six; once the audit is over the Hard Lock Date is set to the same day, from which moment no exception can reopen the year and the Hard Lock Date can never be lowered.
records.formula:
opening balancing item = − ( 12 000.00 + 5 000.00 − 3 000.00 ) = − 14 000.00
invoice balance        = round_to_euro( 1 000.00 ÷ 1.05 ) = 952.38
payment balance        = round_to_euro( 1 000.00 ÷ 1.10 ) = 909.09
matched amount in euros = min( 952.38 , 909.09 ) = 909.09
exchange difference    = 952.38 − 909.09 = 43.29

rounding.what: Every monetary amount of the walkthrough.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the euro, that is 0.01, for the company-currency amounts, and the rounding step of the foreign currency for the foreign amounts.
rounding.step: On each conversion at the moment the amount is written on an item, and on the matched amount before the Partial Reconciliation is stored.

result.name: the ledger of one company over one accounting year
result.unit_or_currency: euro, and the foreign currency for the amounts in currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored as Journal Entries, Journal Items, Partial Reconciliations, Full Reconciliations and hashes; the numbers and the lock dates are displayed to the user.

edge_cases.case: A new entry dated the fifteenth of June is posted after the Global Lock Date has been set to the thirtieth of June.
edge_cases.outcome: Its accounting date is moved out of the locked period by the accounting date rule.

edge_cases.case: A hashed entry is edited.
edge_cases.outcome: It cannot be reset to draft, renumbered, edited in a hashed field, or have an item deleted.

edge_cases.case: The Hard Lock Date has been set to the year end.
edge_cases.outcome: No exception can reopen the year and the Hard Lock Date can never be lowered.

edge_cases.case: The December two thousand and twenty-five chain and the March two thousand and twenty-six chain.
edge_cases.outcome: They are different periods of a monthly numbering, so the March chain restarts at the counter one.

worked_examples.description: The whole year, from the chart to the year end

expected_outputs.refusal_message_on_a_locked_entry: You cannot add/modify entries prior to and inclusive of: Global Lock Date (06/30/2026).
expected_outputs.hash_message: This journal entry has been secured.

worked_examples.narrative: The opening entry balances at 14 000.00 on the current-year-earnings account and takes the first number of the December two thousand and twenty-five chain; the March chain restarts at the counter one and reaches three; the reversal is a cancelling one and produces a Full Reconciliation on the Suppliers account; the invoice and the payment are matched in the foreign currency for 1 000.00 units, which leaves 43.29 euros on the invoice and produces an exchange loss of 43.29 in the journal EXCH; the quarter is then locked, four entries are hashed in two chains, and the year is finally closed by a soft lock followed by a hard lock that can never be lowered.
